title: Past perfect: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: The streets were wet because it ___ (to rain).
items.explanationEs: Llovió antes de lo que se ve (las calles mojadas): had been raining o had rained. Rained también vale, pero el pasado perfecto deja claro el orden.

items.text: When we arrived at the cinema, the film ___ already ___ (to start).
items.explanationEs: Empezó antes de que llegáramos: had + already + participio.

items.text: I ___ (not / eat) anything, so I was very hungry.

items.explanationEs: Pregunta: had pasa delante del sujeto.

items.source: They had been living in Spain.
answers: They hadn't been living in Spain.
They’d not been living in Spain.

items.sentence: He had never flew before that trip.
items.explanationEs: Después de had, el participio de fly: flown. Flew es el pasado.
